Response call from Metropolis Hotel regarding a male individual lingering around the palm trees area who threatened one of their staff when they approached and asked him to leave; assistance requested to move him along.

Arrived at the response call area and approached the individual, asking him to leave; he denied and refused to leave, claiming he did nothing wrong. Left with no other choice, we phoned the police. While on the call with police he got frustrated and left.
Leaving the response call area but got a reference number from police to call back if he returns. I have forwarded it to Metropolis staff.

sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:29 – 22:30)
items: Received a response call regarding a male vagrant consuming illegal substances outside the side of the Footlocker store.
Afternoon shift on route to response location.

Arrived at response location; the male vagrant was indeed seen on the side of the store. Approached the vagrant and kindly asked him to leave; he was very compliant, so no issues. Waiting for the vagrant to pack his belongings and leave the premises before commencing patrol.

Full sweep lower Queen Street; welfare check on all businesses open within the area. Kiwiana Souvenirs reported a female vagrant stealing and would like her trespassed; we notified the owners that if we see her we will issue a verbal trespass. All clear, no issues to report or identified. Heading to Commercial Bay to commence sweep.
Arrived at Commercial Bay; commencing full sweep.
Full sweep Commercial Bay; all clear, no issues identified. Continuing patrols up Albert St.

Full sweep Federal St; no issues identified. Arriving at Victoria St West.

Arrived at Headquarters; charging Ops phone due to low percentage.
Standing by at HQ awaiting night shift for handover.
Afternoon shift complete; handover to night shift.
